pairs.target: sāntiān hòu , nài lěi de huíxìn dào le . zhǐ zhé dé hòu , wàitou lìng chán le yìquān xìshéng , tǎ wéi chāikāi shí xiān diào chū yìzhāng xiǎo huà :
pairs.english: Three days later Nerai's reply arrived. The thickly folded papers were wound with a fine cord; when Tavi opened them, a little drawing fell out first:
pairs.hanzi: 三天后，奈蕾的回信到了。纸折得厚，外头另缠了一圈细绳，塔维拆开时先掉出一张小画：

pairs.target: jǐjiān wūzi wāiwāixiéxié lì zài shuǐshàng , wū xià búshì xìcháng de jiǎo , shì bìngpái kǔnzhù de fú mù .
pairs.english: Several houses stood crookedly on the water, supported not by slender legs but by floating logs lashed side by side.
pairs.hanzi: 几间屋子歪歪斜斜立在水上，屋下不是细长的脚，是并排捆住的浮木。

pairs.target: tā yǐwéi zìjǐ ná dǎo le , jiāng zhǐ zhuǎn le yìquān , cái kànjiàn ménbiān huà zhe yígè títǒng de rén . wūzi zhēn zài shuǐshàng .
pairs.english: Thinking he held it upside down, he turned the paper full circle before noticing someone carrying a bucket drawn by a door. The houses really were on the water.
pairs.hanzi: 他以为自己拿倒了，将纸转了一圈，才看见门边画着一个提桶的人。屋子真在水上。

pairs.target: pángbiān xiě zhe shí tīng èr zì , xiàmiàn yòu yǒu yíjù : huà de shì qùnián qiūtiān , bù bǎozhèng jīnnián réng zài yuánchù .
pairs.english: Beside them was the name Shiting, with a line below: drawn last autumn; no guarantee they're still in the same place this year.
pairs.hanzi: 旁边写着石汀二字，下面又有一句：画的是去年秋天，不保证今年仍在原处。

pairs.target: ruǎn héng zhèshí zhèngzài tóng dù chéng suàn tuōjià de fǎn yùn .
pairs.english: Ruan Heng was then discussing the cradle's return shipment with Du Cheng.
pairs.hanzi: 阮衡这时正在同杜澄算托架的返运。

pairs.target: liǎngzhōu de shì pái zuò wán , shōuhuò de rén yuànyì zài zhào xiàndìng de qīngzǎi yǔ xiāngdǐ lún liǎngzhōu , xùnliàn réng lìng suàn gōngshí .
pairs.english: The two-week trial rota was over. The receiving crew were willing to rotate another two weeks within the light-load and crate-base restrictions, training still counted separately as work hours.
pairs.hanzi: 两周的试排做完，收货的人愿意再照限定的轻载与箱底轮两周，训练仍另算工时。

pairs.target: huíchéng duō zhàn de dìfāng yě jì le xiàlái , bìng búshì shǎo chāi jǐxiāng biàn néng chùchù shěngqián .
pairs.english: The extra space occupied on the return trip had been recorded too; unpacking fewer crates didn't save money everywhere.
pairs.hanzi: 回程多占的地方也记了下来，并不是少拆几箱便能处处省钱。

pairs.target: wēn xiù tíchū lìng zuò yìzhī liúzài fēng zhàn , dàn dé xiān zuò wán , chá guò , zài zǒu kōngxiāng yǔ hédìng qīngzǎi de shìyùn , bùnéng jīnrì zài zhǐ shàng xiě le , míngrì jiùsuàn yǐjīng yǒu liǎngzhī .
pairs.english: Wenxiu proposed making another to keep at Wind Trestle, but it must first be built and checked, then tested with an empty crate and an approved light load. Writing it down today didn't mean two existed tomorrow.
pairs.hanzi: 温岫提出另做一只留在风栈，但得先做完、查过，再走空箱与核定轻载的试运，不能今日在纸上写了，明日就算已经有两只。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi niē zhe xìn zhàn le yíhuìer , děng tāmen tíngbǐ cái kāikǒu . ruǎn héng ràng tā xiāndú , dù chéng běnlái zhǔnbèi chūmén , tīngdào fú wū , fǎndǎo yòu huílái , wèn xià dàyǔ shí zhù de rén zěnme shàng máofáng .
pairs.english: Tavi stood holding the letter a while and spoke only when their pens stopped. Ruan Heng told him to read it first. Du Cheng had been about to leave, but returned on hearing of floating houses and asked how residents used the latrine in heavy rain.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维捏着信站了一会儿，等他们停笔才开口。阮衡让他先读，杜澄本来准备出门，听到浮屋，反倒又回来，问下大雨时住的人怎么上茅房。

pairs.target: xìn lǐ méiyǒu zhèjiàn shì . nài lěi shuō tā yě yǒu jǐchù bìxū dào xiànchǎng zài wèn , shí tīng de rén huì jiāng fú wū yí dào bèi liú chù , kūshuǐ shí yòu yǒu yíbùfen gē zài shítān shàng .
pairs.english: The letter didn't say. Nerai wrote that she too had questions to ask on site: Shiting's people moved floating homes out of the current, and some rested on the stony bank at low water.
pairs.hanzi: 信里没有这件事。奈蕾说她也有几处必须到现场再问，石汀的人会将浮屋移到背流处，枯水时又有一部分搁在石滩上。

pairs.target: guòdōng de lǎn wèi , dùchuán héshí huàn àn , bùnéng chāo qùnián yìzhāng tú biàn jiāochāi .
pairs.english: Winter mooring positions and when the ferry changed banks couldn't be settled by copying last year's map.
pairs.hanzi: 过冬的缆位、渡船何时换岸，不能抄去年一张图便交差。

pairs.target: zhèhuí búshì qù zhǎo méi jì zài tú shàng de dìfāng . bái péng yì yǐnán de jǐgè yìzhàn hé qǐng tā chá yíduàn jiùyǒu shuǐlù , huà huàn dù chù yǔ bùxíng jiē lù , gòng láiwǎng de rén shǐyòng .
pairs.english: This wasn't a search for unmapped places. Several stations south of White Awning Station jointly commissioned her to survey an existing water route and map ferry connections and walking links for travelers.
pairs.hanzi: 这回不是去找没记在图上的地方。白棚驿以南的几个驿站合请她查一段旧有水路，画换渡处与步行接路，供来往的人使用。

pairs.target: shí tīng yǒu zhùhù , huòzhàn hé bǎidùrén , yě yǒu bú yuàn zài xīn tú shàng bèi huà chéng yǒngyuǎn tíng zài yuánchù de rénjiā .
pairs.english: Shiting had homes, warehouses, and ferrymen, and households unwilling to be drawn on a new map as staying forever in one place.
pairs.hanzi: 石汀有住户、货栈和摆渡人，也有不愿在新图上被画成永远停在原处的人家。

pairs.target: yǒurén pàn zhe kèrén cóng zìjiā ménqián zǒu , yǒurén nìngyuàn wàikè xiān rào dào zhànfáng wènlù , wěituō de rén bìng méi tì tāmen quán shuōtuǒ .
pairs.english: Some wanted visitors passing their own doors; others preferred outsiders to stop at the warehouse for directions first. The commissioners hadn't settled everything for them.
pairs.hanzi: 有人盼着客人从自家门前走，有人宁愿外客先绕到栈房问路，委托的人并没替他们全说妥。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi jiāng zhè duàn dú màn le xiē . xì lǐ de rén wǎng shānshàng zǒu , táishàng de mén yì guān , wàitou biàn zhī yú yímiàn báibù .
pairs.english: Tavi read this more slowly. The people in the play went uphill, and once the onstage door closed, outside there remained only a white cloth.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维将这段读慢了些。戏里的人往山上走，台上的门一关，外头便只余一面白布。

pairs.target: nài lěi de xìn què xiě nàlǐ zǎofàn yǒu yú gān , qùnián yíwèi lǎotàitài yǎng de jī pàshuǐ , zhěngtiān zhàn zài wūdǐng màrén . xìnzhǐ zuìhòu de kōng chù hái tiān le yìxiǎo zhī jī , bǐ nà jǐjiān wūzi huà dé rènzhēn .
pairs.english: Nerai's letter, though, described dried fish for breakfast and an old woman's chicken last year that feared water and scolded everyone from a roof all day. In the last blank space she'd added a little chicken, drawn more carefully than the houses.
pairs.hanzi: 奈蕾的信却写那里早饭有鱼干，去年一位老太太养的鸡怕水，整天站在屋顶骂人。信纸最后的空处还添了一小只鸡，比那几间屋子画得认真。

pairs.target: tā wèn tǎ wéi yuànbuyuàn jiē bātiān de suíxíng huàtú yǔ chāo jì , cóng yuēdìng de huìhé rì suàn qǐ , zhùchù , chēchuán yǔ bàochóu dōu liè le shù .
pairs.english: She asked whether Tavi would take eight days of accompanying sketch and transcription work from the agreed meeting date, listing accommodation, transport, and payment amounts.
pairs.hanzi: 她问塔维愿不愿接八天的随行画图与抄记，从约定的会合日算起，住处、车船与报酬都列了数。

pairs.target: zàn yì shísāntiān hòu zài bái péng yì huìhé , cìrì zài wǎng nán , jùtǐ xíngchéng suí xiàn dì shuǐqíng diàozhěng , bùnéng wèile còu mǎn mǒu yìtiān , yìng zǒu yǐjīng bùnéng zǒu de dùkǒu .
pairs.english: The provisional meeting was at White Awning Station thirteen days later, heading south the following day, with the itinerary adjusted to local water conditions rather than forcing an unusable crossing to fill a particular day.
pairs.hanzi: 暂议十三天后在白棚驿会合，次日再往南，具体行程随现地水情调整，不能为了凑满某一天，硬走已经不能走的渡口。

pairs.target: tā dài jiào de zhè duàn gōngzuò yě dé xiān xiě jìn shí zuò ānpái , jiāojiē gěi xuégōng hé ruǎn héng , réng yóu tā guǎn zhěngduàn shí zuò , búshì ná yíkuài bái pái bǎ xuéshēng dàizǒu .
pairs.english: This work under her supervision also had to be entered in the placement plan and handed over to the academy and Ruan Heng, who would still oversee the whole placement; a white tally alone wasn't leave to take a student away.
pairs.hanzi: 她带教的这段工作也得先写进实作安排，交接给学宫和阮衡，仍由他管整段实作，不是拿一块白牌把学生带走。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi dú dào zhèlǐ , tái yǎnkàn ruǎn héng . " bātiān , wǒ néng qù ma ? "
pairs.english: Tavi looked up at Ruan Heng at this point. “Eight days. Can I go?”
pairs.hanzi: 塔维读到这里，抬眼看阮衡。“八天，我能去吗？”

pairs.target: ruǎn héng méiyǒu lìkè shuō néng , shǒu què shēnxiàng zhuōshàng de zhǐjiá , jiāng nà zhāng huíxiào tōngzhī chōuchūlái .
pairs.english: Ruan Heng didn't say yes immediately, but reached for the folder on the table and pulled out the school-return notice.
pairs.hanzi: 阮衡没有立刻说能，手却伸向桌上的纸夹，将那张回校通知抽出来。

pairs.target: " xiān kàn zhè shìbushì nǐ xiǎng xué de . búshì yīnwèi tā de páizi hǎokàn . "
pairs.english: “First see if this is what you want to learn. Not because her tally looks fine.”
pairs.hanzi: “先看这是不是你想学的。不是因为她的牌子好看。”

pairs.target: " wǒ xiǎng zhīdào nàxiē rén zěnme zhù . " tǎ wéi shuō , " yě xiǎng xué tā zěnme huà . búshì zhàn zài gāochù , bǎ shuǐ yìquān , rén jiù huà méi le . "
pairs.english: “I want to know how those people live,” Tavi said. “And learn how she draws. Not stand up high, draw a circle round the water, and make the people vanish.”
pairs.hanzi: “我想知道那些人怎么住。”塔维说，“也想学她怎么画。不是站在高处，把水一圈，人就画没了。”

pairs.target: dù chéng zài pángbiān xiào le yìshēng , shuō nà dǎo gāi bǎ máofáng yě huà shàng .
pairs.english: Du Cheng laughed beside them and said then he ought to draw the latrines too.
pairs.hanzi: 杜澄在旁边笑了一声，说那倒该把茅房也画上。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi liǎn rè qǐlái , ruǎn héng yě xiào , děng xiàoshēng guòqù , cái tóng tā kàn bātiān lǐ jiūjìng yóu shuí dài , yùdào gǎidào xiàng shuí bào , jiè xìng liànxí zài nǎ tíng .
pairs.english: Tavi's face warmed, and Ruan Heng laughed too. Once the laughter passed, he went through who would supervise the eight days, who would be notified of detours, and where borrowing practice would stop.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维脸热起来，阮衡也笑，等笑声过去，才同他看八天里究竟由谁带、遇到改道向谁报、借性练习在哪停。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi jiāng wéi lǎoshī de xǔkě fàngzài lìngyìbiān , zìjǐ shuō zhèhuí bú dài tiě duì , bù bǎ jiājù kè de zhǔnxǔ dài chéng lùshang suíshǒu néng yòng de dōngxī .
pairs.english: Tavi set Instructor Vey's permission aside and said himself that he wouldn't bring the iron pair this time or turn fixture-class permission into leave to use it casually on the road.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维将维老师的许可放在另一边，自己说这回不带铁对，不把夹具课的准许带成路上随手能用的东西。

pairs.target: ruǎn héng bǎ zhè jù huà jì jìn zhǔnbèi jiāo xuégōng de ānpái lǐ , bātiān de bàochóu lìng liè , bùtóng yuányǒu shí zuò de bǔtiē jiǎo chéng yìbǐ .
pairs.english: Ruan Heng added this to the plan for the academy, listing the eight days' payment separately from the existing placement stipend rather than mixing them.
pairs.hanzi: 阮衡把这句话记进准备交学宫的安排里，八天的报酬另列，不同原有实作的补贴搅成一笔。

pairs.target: hái méiyǒu nǎ yíchù xiě shàng yǐjīng huòzhǔn , tāmen huíxiào shí néng dāng miàntán , búbì zài jiào yìfēngxìn dài tā bǎ suǒyǒu huà shuōwán .
pairs.english: Nothing said approved yet. They could discuss it in person back at school; a letter needn't do all his talking for him.
pairs.hanzi: 还没有哪一处写上已经获准，他们回校时能当面谈，不必再叫一封信代他把所有话说完。

pairs.target: bàngwǎn tǎ wéi fùqián jìchū duǎnduǎnde huíxìn , quèrèn shōudào le tú yǔ yuēqī , qǐng nài lěi xiān liú dào huíxiào tán guò yǐhòu , xià yìfēng kě jì bái jiē xuégōng .
pairs.english: That evening Tavi paid to post a short reply, acknowledging the drawing and proposed date, asking Nerai to hold it until after the school discussion and send her next letter to the White Steps academy.
pairs.hanzi: 傍晚塔维付钱寄出短短的回信，确认收到了图与约期，请奈蕾先留到回校谈过以后，下一封可寄白阶学宫。

pairs.target: tā jiāng gěi chí ān nà fēngxìn de zhuǎnjì dìzhǐ yòu hé le yíbiàn , méiyǒu xīn huíxìn , yě méi bǎ nàjiànshì tiān dào nài lěi de shuǐlù shang .
pairs.english: He checked the forwarding address for his letter to Chian again. There was no new reply, and he didn't add that matter to Nerai's water route.
pairs.hanzi: 他将给迟安那封信的转寄地址又核了一遍，没有新回信，也没把那件事添到奈蕾的水路上。

pairs.target: yèlǐ tā bǎ shí tīng de xiǎo huà yāpíng , méi wǎng chuāngwài wàng . fú mù shàng nàge títǒng de rén , jiǎo biān yuánlái hái zhàn zhe yígè gèng xiǎo de yǐngzi , xiàng zài děng dàrén téng chūshǒu , jiāng tǒng fēn tā yìzhī .
pairs.english: That night he flattened the little Shiting drawing without looking out the window. Beside the bucket carrier's feet on the logs stood a smaller figure, as if waiting for the adult to free a hand and give him a bucket.
pairs.hanzi: 夜里他把石汀的小画压平，没往窗外望。浮木上那个提桶的人，脚边原来还站着一个更小的影子，像在等大人腾出手，将桶分他一只。
